lesson.title: How a parabola grows
lesson.goal: Connect the height of a parabola to its tangent slope and the area beneath it.

say: Graph the square of x. At two steps on either side of zero, the curve reaches a height of four.
Slide the coefficient down to one half. Every height is now half what it was.
Draw the tangent at one. Its slope is one, so the line rises one unit for every unit to the right.
Shade the area from zero to two. The heights across that whole interval contribute four thirds of a square unit.
